items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: I remember that was before I started playing the music... from what I was told and when I got up and playing there used to play that thing and he used to make that and he used to holler Jack Kerrer

ctx.x: now I want to tell you about Tiger Ragg and Jack Kerr I remember that was before I started playing the music playing the music playing the music playing the music playing the music playing the music playing the music playing the music playing before I started playing the music playing the band used to pass there on the corner on the way we was living on ramparts but of course the majority of the time together as Undertaker they called it Jack Kerrer but it was nothing but Tiger Ragg and Jack Kerrer from what I…
Well anyway, what would be the fastest number you'd ever play? Oh I tell you the fastest
